notes: Winter holiday pool (season:winter): holiday trees and Yule hearth pieces up top, frosted trees and snow in the middle, small seasonal touches at the bottom. 'tier' is the catalog tier and can be used as event drop rarity (the Classic Holiday Tree, which the era evidence documents as a December 1998 and 1999 holiday gift, is the single extremely-rare). Most of the snow and ice crags went to the Ice curator and the Nemesis pool, so this set leans on holiday trees, frosted trees and Yule fire. The Little Snowman (CR-SEA-014) is deliberately left out: the era notes put its art in the 2003 winter package. Every piece here is grade A or B. Winter art has no function; whether these are event drops, a vendor's seasonal stock or both is for the Retention roadmap item.

entries.why: Classic holiday tree hung with baubles, the winter showpiece
Wide crooked oak with its bare limbs thick with frost
Slim holiday cedar strung with baubles
Narrow frosted tree sparkling with coloured baubles
Tall frosted cypress hung with icicles
Frosted cedar standing like a pale spire
Tall snow mound drifted against a buried stump
Yule log burning through the longest night
Red, green and white yuletide candles
Pair of ruby and emerald yuletide lanterns
Leafless frosted elm, every twig outlined in white
Round snow heap swept against a doorstep
Frosted willow, switches stiff with ice
Plain cedar tree, the humble winter evergreen
